# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::status_dot`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

A small filled dot in a status tone (`widget.status-dot`): 8 px, no glow, ring or pulse. A dot
never stands alone: the word beside it carries the meaning, so [`Ui::status_dot`](../ui.md#method.Ui.status_dot) draws the
dot only together with its word and [`paint`](status_dot.md#fn.paint) is for widgets that embed a dot (the badge).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/status_dot.rs:1`
